note: ADR-0011 §3.2 first bars. The detector hears only its band, so the tests drive it with a tone at the frequency setting (6.5 kHz), where the band-pass has 0 dB gain and the bell its full cut. Static gain against the Giannoulis et al. curve; attack and release are 63 % times of the gain change in dB from step tests in wide mode, where the gain is per sample; with no reduction the bell is the identity. The sibilant zipper sweeps read a 2 kHz tone through the bell (HF residue, bar moved down by the tone's 6 dB) and the gain of a 100 Hz tone carrying an 8 kHz sibilant (wide), since the standard 100 Hz tone never reaches the band.
